artifacts.summary: 3-phase plan (~2.75h) making Mechanism A's Batch Gate Deferral directive emit --skip-unchanged as the sanctioned cheap probe and a no-additional-full-sweep obligation, syncing four consumer contracts and the derived index line counts, then redeploying.

memory_candidates.content: The two narrowing invocations orchestrate's Batch Gate Deferral directive emits are NOT symmetric in flag support: verify-deploy.sh parses --skip-unchanged, but scripts/tests/run-all.sh does not -- its argument loop ends in a catch-all arm that exits 2 with 'ERROR: unknown argument'. Any proposal to apply the gate cache to both narrowing forms must either stop at verify-deploy.sh or first add the flag to run-all.sh. The asymmetry is also benign: a narrowed run-all.sh --only run explicitly skips the specs/.gate-lock bracket, so it never carries the mutex contention the cache fast path exists to relieve.
